text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Have you seen any handouts 
around here? The moment I opened the 
window, they blew right away...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—No, there is no need for concern. This, 
too, is a trial to reach 'that place.'”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even if my bag strap snaps and spills 
everything, even if the soup next to me 
splashes at lunch... ...it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships come my way, I 
will overcome them. After all—I am a 
saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Setting that aside, where did those 
handouts go?"
